title: What does varsity rugby cost?
note: Illustrative first-year figures from a real proposal. Years 2–5 run at about $151,000 — the one-time equipment spend does not repeat. Every college's numbers differ.

items.label: Shares existing grass — no new build

ledger.title: The other side of the ledger
ledger.lead: Rugby is enrollment-funded. The cost only makes sense read against the students it brings in.

stats.label: incremental students cover the annual program cost, at typical net tuition
roster growth by Year 5 — one of the largest in college sport

ledger.note: Incremental students — those who would not otherwise have enrolled — are not the same as total roster size. The enrollment case should be built on the former.
